newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat up late, fast trade, as commercials buy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat up late, fast trade, as commercials buy.

text.p: CBOT soft red winter wheat futures moved higher in late dealings with September and December in fast trading on commercial buying, traders said.
"Cargill's buying got some attention," a trader said.
Cargill Inc had purchased up to three million bushels of September and two million bushels of December as of 1250 CDT, traders said.
At 1251 CDT, soft red winter wheat futures were 1-1/2 to three cents higher, with July up two at $3.30-1/2. September was up two at $3.38.
